Join Ustazah Nur Hidayah from 2-8
November for a transformative 7D6N soul-healing retreat filled with reflection, worship, meaningful connection and unforgettable experiences.
Your journey includes:
Daily halaqah sessions
Tahajjud prayers in congregation / A unique stay in a traditional yurt
Horseback riding amid the natural beauty
of Kolsai Lake
* Visits to Charyn Canyon and Shymbulak
Mountain Resort
Round-trip flights, ground transport and
admission fees
• Half-board meals
Intimate sharing circles
A fully guided experience led by your
dedicated retreat host
